evidenceLimits: World dimensions are Editor renderer AABBs in Unity metres, not certified authored dimensions. Mesh local sizes are unscaled imported units. Runtime-created objects and conditional build injections need separate evidence.
conditionalRuntimeEvidence: CombinedGraphicsReviewBuilder injects ReviewEffects and the atmosphere pipeline. Candidate rifle meshes/AO and water shader are conditional build inputs, not serialized scene bindings. HUD, effects and some materials are built in code. Resources inclusion alone is not proof of runtime use.
